what: Append-only supplement for SL-3: the "Have you seen…?" exchange spoken. Your question about each person you can ask after (your voice) and every answer an asker can give, listed once for each asker (code.wb): sightings on the asker's map and the ones beside it (ways out and buildings' doors), usual places, recollections, refusals, not knowing; plus anything else the script gained since SL1.
authorization: Robin, 2026-10-19: 'The "have you seen" dialogue interactions have no voiced lines from either the player nor the NPC I've talked to - tried with Bunta and Tomo'; and 'every line in-game should have spoken lines with properly highlightable text as well'. Local's batch continues unchanged; these are new recordings appended after it.

builtFrom.command: node tools/voice/supplement.mjs --id SL3 (tools/voice/production_manifest.mjs into a scratch directory, compared by id with the GO manifest and the earlier supplements)
